Found 78 items in registries @oidc:

Showing items 1-78 of 78:

- core (registry:block) - A starter policy form: GitHub Actions and Vercel behind a toggle picker, each form with its own submit. The file is yours — add providers, swap the picker, and wire onSubmit to your storage. The builder at the homepage generates this file for any provider combination. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- policy (registry:lib) - The OidcPolicy rule type, its matching semantics, validation, and the match/explain functions. No dependencies — the foundation every other oidc-ui item builds on. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- verify (registry:lib) - Server-side token verification against OidcPolicy rules: OIDC discovery with issuer assertion, JWKS caching with stale fallback, signature and expiry checks via jose, and named error codes. Claim matching comes from @oidc/policy. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- claims (registry:component) - The shared pieces every provider form composes: the ClaimsList row editor for additional claims, the ClaimChip label marker, and the pure helpers that merge rows into a policy and read them back out. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- picker (registry:component) - Single-select provider picker that adapts to the count: a toggle row for up to three providers, a select beyond that, nothing for one. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- page-actions (registry:block) - A working settings page: app/settings/oidc renders the policy form, and a server action validates with validateOidcPolicy before saving. Wire the form's onSubmit to savePolicy and replace the console.log with your storage. [@oidc] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
